_notes: Universal card-extraction template. Every card (credit, debit, prepaid; any issuer) fills this same shape. Use null for 'not yet verified / unknown', use the string "N/A" for 'this field genuinely does not apply to this card' (e.g. cash_advance on a debit card, invite_only fields on an open-application card), and use [] for 'verified — this card has none of these'. Never delete a key because it doesn't apply — mark it N/A so downstream ingestion can tell 'not applicable' apart from 'not scraped yet'.

sources.kind: Suryoday SSFB RuPay Platinum (MobiKwik) Key Fact Statement
issuer listing page (MobiKwik First tile: "1% Cashback*"; page footnote "#With the capping of ₹3,000"), re-read 2026-11-07 in the built-in browser

MobiKwik (co-brand partner, not issuer) product page: "Flat 1% Cashback* on UPI and Online spends"; FAQ "1% Cashback on all Ecommerce transactions" and "1% Cashback on UPI payments made via MobiKwik UPI"; no terms link for the cashback

Generic Suryoday RuPay Platinum MITC (file dated 17 Jun 2026, 30 pages), clause "l) CASH BACK PROGRAM": states no rate, cap, period or merchant list; used only to confirm the cashback rules are not in it

open_questions: Cashback (checked 2026-11-07, W6): no document that states the cap, period, exclusions or minimum transaction for the 1% cashback was found, so no reward rule is written. The issuer listing page links a cashback PDF only for the Stable Money cards (0.5%; stablemoney-suryoday-sfb-credit-card-cashback.pdf); the MobiKwik tile has no "Know More" link. The page links a MobiKwik MITC (https://suryoday.bank.in/assets/pdf/MITC_SSFB_RuPay_Platinum_Credit_MBK.pdf) but that URL returns a 404 page. The MobiKwik KFS (https://suryoday.bank.in/assets/pdf/KFS_SSFB_RuPay_Platinum_Credit_MBK.pdf, file dated 24 Jun 2026) has fees only and no reward terms; the generic Suryoday MITC cashback clause gives no rate or cap. The issuer page footnote "#With the capping of ₹3,000" is attached to the product line as a whole and does not say per month or per statement cycle or that it covers this variant. The MobiKwik page says 1% on e-commerce and 1% on UPI payments made via MobiKwik UPI, which is a partner statement, not an issuer term. effective_base_return_percent 1 is the advertised figure only. Hold this card until Suryoday or MobiKwik publishes the cashback terms.
KFS carries no revision date in its text; the PDF metadata shows 24 Jun 2026.
Do not reuse the Stable Money card's zero forex: this card charges 2.5% + GST (KFS).
Late payment fee: 2.5% of the outstanding or ₹250 + GST, whichever is higher (KFS); cannot be shown as fixed slabs.
notes: Cash advances are restricted to 20% of the credit limit; cash advance fee 2.5% of the amount, minimum ₹500 + GST (KFS).
Fuel surcharge waiver is limited to ₹40,000 in a calendar month with no single transaction above ₹8,000 (KFS).

value.rule: 2.5% of the outstanding, or ₹250 + GST, whichever is higher
